period.errorRange: Use 0 for never, or 30 to 3650 days.

plan.error: We could not calculate it. Nothing was changed.
plan.invalid: Fix the periods to see the plan.
plan.sentence: Of {total} orders: {stays} stay as they are, {hidden} will leave the lists (can be undone), {erased} will lose personal data (cannot be undone).
plan.sentenceWhole: Of {total} orders: {stays} stay as they are, {hidden} will leave the lists (can be undone), {erased} will leave the lists and lose personal data (cannot be undone).
plan.skippedWhy: Orders with an open return, a hold or an invoice being issued are skipped. They rejoin the run once the reason is gone.
plan.title: What will happen
plan.untouchedBackupsText: We do not change backups of the OpenLinker database.
plan.untouchedInvoicesText: Issued invoices and receipts are not changed.
plan.untouchedShops: Orders in your shop and marketplace
plan.untouchedShopsText: We only change OpenLinker's copy of the order.

record.ribbonHidden: Hidden from the lists, can be restored
record.ribbonHiddenErased: Hidden, personal data erased for good
record.ribbonVisibleErased: On the list, personal data erased for good
record.tableLabel: The order today and after the rules
record.title: Example order

rules.eraseBeforeHide: Personal data cannot be erased before the order is hidden.
rules.eraseDescription: Counted from the day the order was placed. Erased data cannot be restored.
rules.hideDescription: The order leaves the lists but stays in OpenLinker. You find it under the "Hidden orders" filter.
rules.irreversibleBody: Erased personal data cannot be restored, not even by syncing the order again. Issued invoices and receipts are not changed.
rules.modeDescriptionPersonal: Name, email, phone, tax number and address are replaced with a code such as BUYER-000123. Amounts and products stay.
rules.modeDescriptionWhole: When the data is erased, the order is also hidden from the lists. Amounts and products stay in OpenLinker.
rules.summaryEraseNever: Personal data is kept without a time limit.
rules.summaryEraseWhole: Orders are hidden and personal data erased {when}.

scope.defaultsLead: Default rules for every connection that has none of its own.
scope.disabledHere: Switched off for this connection. Its rules are set, but nothing is hidden or erased here.
scope.hintDraft: Draft. The rules start working once saved.
scope.hintOn: The rules are on and applied regularly in the background.
scope.hintReady: The plan is calculated. The rules stay off until you turn them on.
scope.hintWaiting: The rules are off. You can turn them on once the plan for these settings is calculated.
scope.linkedLead: Follows the default settings. Change the default settings.
scope.ownFollows: Follows the shared switch, currently: {state}. Switch it off here to leave out only this connection.
scope.ownLead: This connection has its own cut-offs.
